map.记录文件版本号、修订说明与作者，支持语义化版本号（SemVer），数据保存在浏览: Records version numbers, revision notes and authors, supports semantic versioning (SemVer), and stores data in the browser locally
map.需求文档、设计方案每次修订后，按'修订/次版本/主版本'三类升版，自动给出建议版: After each revision of a requirements doc or design, bump the version by 'patch/minor/major', which auto-suggests the version number to keep the team aligned.
map.设计稿发生不兼容的重大改版时，使用主版本（Major）升版并提示需同步通知下游，: When a design has an incompatible major revision, bump the major version (Major) and prompt notifying downstream to avoid misuse of the old version.
map.周报、会议纪要等小修小补用修订（Patch）升版，既留痕又不抬高版本预期。: Minor edits to weekly reports or meeting minutes use a patch bump, leaving a trace without inflating version expectations.
map.：当前版本 1.2.3：选'修订(Patch)'→ 1.2.4（修正错别字/微调: : current version 1.2.3: choose 'Patch' → 1.2.4 (typo fixes/minor tweaks); 'Minor' → 1.3.0 (new requirement section, low digits reset); 'Major' → 2.0.0 (full refactor, minor/patch reset). The tool also records the reviser and revision notes, forming a traceable version chain.
map.语义化版本号（SemVer）怎么读？: How do you read a SemVer version?
map.格式为主版本.次版本.修订号（X.Y.Z）。主版本变表示不兼容改动，次版本变表示: The format is major.minor.patch (X.Y.Z). A major change means an incompatible change, a minor change a backward-compatible new feature, and a patch a backward-compatible bug fix. When a low digit is bumped, higher digits reset (e.g. after 1.3.0 comes 1.3.1).
map.多人同时改一份文档怎么避免版本乱？: How do multiple people avoid version chaos on one document?
map.约定'谁改谁升版并填修订说明'，主版本变更须通知所有协作者；配合共享盘或 Git: Agree that 'whoever changes bumps the version and fills in the revision note', and that a major change must notify all collaborators; use a shared drive or a Git-like concurrent lock, pulling the latest before editing. The tool generates standard version numbers and keeps a trace, but does not replace a collaboration process.
